items.prompt: Why can a slightly higher quoted buy price have lower all-in cost?

options.text: Its explicit fee can be sufficiently lower
options.why: Compare matched quantity/currency and complete fee assumptions.
Price times quantity is part of cost.

options.text: A per-order fee can be ignored whenever the per-share quote is lower
options.why: Total order cost includes the fee as well as price times quantity.

options.text: A better quoted price always offsets any fixed fee at every order size
options.why: The per-share effect of a fixed fee depends on the number of shares.

items.explanation: In the frozen fixture, B's one-cent worse quote is outweighed by A's 50 cent fee on 10 shares.
